correctness.rationale: Reconstructed and checked every quantifier and normalization: conditional Chinese remainder theorem gives independent quotient residues modulo coprime reduced moduli; total covariance is exactly (gcd(a,b)^2−1)/12. Bilinear expansion yields exact mean and variance; the classical identity gcd^2=sum_{d|gcd}J_2(d) yields the Jordan sum. Möbius inversion proves sum_{d≤x}J_2(d)=x^3/(3ζ(3))+O(x^2), and summation of floor-square layers gives the cubic constant with O(m² log(2m)) error. Chebyshev and the exact mean shift yield O_epsilon(1/m) concentration. Boundary m=1 and equal/copime moduli checked. Independent exact rational replay: all 400 covariance pairs through 20, full-period moment checks m≤9, and 150 gcd/Jordan comparisons. Numerical checks are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The 2025 introducing paper explicitly identifies statistical behavior of aggregate remainders as an open research direction. An exact complete-period second moment, nonzero sharp cubic constant, and quantitative concentration law determine the natural fluctuation scale of that observable; its denominator-period sampling is canonical and not an unmotivated slice. The result is stronger than a finite table or a direct restatement of periodicity, and does not claim an unproved central limit theorem.
